cases.name: oversize_payload_missing_content_length
cases.note: A declared-Content-Length-only size check has nothing to reject here; the streamed-byte-count guard must catch it instead.

cases.name: oversize_payload_lying_content_length
cases.content_length_header: present but understated (declares 1 byte while the actual body is far larger)
cases.note: Proves the size ceiling is enforced against bytes actually streamed, not the caller-controlled header value.

cases.name: oversize_payload_chunked_transfer_encoding
cases.content_length_header: absent (chunked transfer-encoding, delivered across several ASGI messages)
cases.note: Chunked transfer-encoding carries no Content-Length at all - proves the guard works across a multi-message body, not just a single one.
